notes: Account background: mid-market SaaS that runs a product insights console for European SMBs. High trust requirement from customers (banking, fintech startups).
Primary ask: start with Hosted API for fast time-to-value, then move to Dedicated once throughput & residency needs mature.
Use-case detail: user-facing chat assistant (quick answers + doc retrieval) + nightly embedding index updates. Need sub-200ms P99 for chat in EU where possible.
POC observations: hosted eu endpoint achieved median 95ms token latency in tests (seq len 64), but P95 spikes to ~450ms under bursty traffic. They flagged spikes as unacceptable for support chat SLA.

Routing/residency concern: product security lead said 'we cannot route PII or customer metadata outside EU without explicit consent' — important constraint. Team comfortable with multi-region for non-PII telemetry only.
Dedicated ask: predictable throughput (50-100 concurrent chat sessions) and option for burst to other regions but with residency exceptions. Interested in VPC + customer KMS.
Pricing discussion: wants committed monthly for 12 months if Dedicated beats hosted TCO; asked for 'burst buffer' pricing and overage mechanics.
Tech constraints: runs EU cloud region (primary in eu-west-1), strict retention (30-day logs), retention controls + export restrictions required.
Legal: requested DPA + SCC template; wants explicit statement on where failover traffic may be routed and whether tokenized content is allowed to leave EU.
Suggested Redwood levers discussed: EU-only Dedicated pool, prefix/KV caching to reduce tokens, quantized model suggestions for lower cost, canary rollouts for model updates.
POC deliverables agreed: 2-week EU-only Hosted POC with synthetic traffic, 1-week Dedicated pilot in eu region (if metrics good), latency/throughput report + cost model.
Quote from product lead: 'If Dedicated gets P99 under 250ms in EU and pricing is within 2x hosted, we can convert to reserved capacity.'
